title: pi-subagents settings (subagents.json)
description: Hand-derived from SubagentsSettings in @tintinweb/pi-subagents 0.18.1 (dist/settings.d.ts). Global file: ~/.pi/agent/subagents.json (manual defaults). Project file: <cwd>/.pi/subagents.json, written by /agents -> Settings; overrides global on load. Unknown keys are ignored on load, out-of-range numbers are dropped.

$schema.description: Path to this schema; ignored by the extension.

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum subagents running at once. Default 10.

defaultMaxTurns.description: Default turn cap per subagent; 0 = unlimited.

graceTurns.description: Extra turns granted after the cap so the agent can wrap up.

defaultJoinMode.description: How multiple background spawns report back by default.

backgroundByDefault.description: Whether an unqualified top-level Agent spawn runs detached. Default true (Claude Code behaviour); false makes unqualified spawns block and return inline. Nested spawns always default to foreground.

schedulingEnabled.description: Master switch for scheduled subagents. Default true. When false the schedule param is stripped from the tool spec (applies next session) and the scheduler never binds.

scopeModels.description: Validate each spawn's effective model against pi's enabledModels. Caller-supplied out-of-scope models hard-error; frontmatter-pinned or parent-inherited ones warn and run. Default false.

strictAgentFiles.description: Abort extension load (pi exits, naming the file) on an unreadable or unparseable agent .md instead of skipping with a warning. Startup only. Default false.

disableDefaultAgents.description: Suppress the built-in default agents (general-purpose, Explore, Plan) at startup. Custom agents unaffected. Default false.

toolDescriptionMode.description: Which Agent tool description the LLM sees. full (default), compact (~75% smaller for small/local models), or custom (reads .pi/agent-tool-description.md with {{placeholder}} substitution). Read once at tool registration.

fleetView.description: Show the navigable main+subagents FleetView below the editor. Default true. Pure UI.

agentMentions.description: Routing for @handle typed at the prompt: model (default, main model spawns it via the Agent tool), direct (typed text becomes the agent's prompt, no main-model turn), or off. Applied live.

rememberAgents.description: Persist each subagent's pi session so @handle can reopen its conversation later; persisted sessions also nest under the spawning session in /resume. Default true. Per-agent persist_session frontmatter overrides.

widgetMode.description: Above-editor agent widget: all agents, background only (default; foreground already renders inline), or off. Applied live.

outputTranscript.description: Write each subagent's .output JSON-lines transcript under the OS temp dir. Default true. Per-agent output_transcript frontmatter overrides. Transcript only; does not affect persisted sessions, worktrees, or memory.

worktreeIsolation.description: Allow isolation: worktree to create worktrees. Default true. When false a requested worktree is silently dropped and the agent runs in the main checkout; the isolation capability is also hidden from the tool spec.

maxSubagentDepth.description: Nesting ceiling counted from the main session (main = 0). Default 2; 0 or 1 disables nesting.

fallbackSubagent.description: Agent type substituted when subagent_type doesn't resolve. Omitted = general-purpose fallback; an agent name routes there; "none" (or false) fails closed with an error naming available types.

reportUsage.description: Attach usage to tool results so subagent spend reaches the parent session's /cost and statusline. Tokens exclude cacheRead; unpriced models contribute 0. Default false.

showCost.description: Show an estimated dollar cost (~$0.0042) next to token counts in subagent surfaces; omitted when the model has no pricing. Default false. Applied live.

showModel.description: Show model and thinking level on the widget's running rows. Default false.

viewerMarkdown.description: How much of the conversation viewer renders as Markdown. Default assistant; all also renders tool results (lossy). The viewer's m key cycles this same setting.
